discovery: The gauge/gravity (AdS/CFT) holographic duality between quantum gravity and gauge theory

nominees.name: Juan Maldacena
nominees.affiliation: Institute for Advanced Study, Princeton, USA

nominees.name: Edward Witten
nominees.affiliation: Institute for Advanced Study, Princeton, USA

motivation: In 1997 Maldacena conjectured that string theory on anti-de Sitter space is exactly equivalent to a conformal gauge theory on its boundary. Witten, and Gubser, Klebanov and Polyakov, then gave the precise dictionary relating bulk fields to boundary operators, which turned the conjecture into a working tool. Holography is the first non-perturbative definition of quantum gravity. It shows that black-hole evaporation is unitary and that spacetime geometry emerges from quantum entanglement, through the Ryu-Takayanagi formula and later derivations of Einstein's equations from entanglement. It has changed how physicists study strongly coupled matter, including quark-gluon plasma viscosity, non-Fermi liquids and quantum chaos, and it connects quantum information science with gravity. Direct gravitational tests are not yet possible, but its predictions have been checked by exact computations and by the success of holographic methods in nuclear and condensed-matter physics. This is the deepest conceptual reorganisation of fundamental physics in a generation.
